text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Super Creek,
I walked her back near the dorms, and—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, walking me back out of concern... You really are so kind, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still, around here should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even though it's close by, please make sure to get home safely, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much♪

As Super Creek turned her back,
I casually looked up at the sky.

...The stars are really out tonight.
Maybe they'd look even prettier from somewhere with less light.

Since we're here, maybe I should invite Super Creek?
...—Then again, maybe not.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When I looked back, you seemed to be spacing out,
so I was a bit concerned...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you all right?
"...It really is getting late. I'd better hold off on inviting her out to look at the stars."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

After parting ways with Super Creek,
I headed to the riverbank alone.

At this hour, naturally,
not a single person was around.
As I sat down somewhere to enjoy the starry sky—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I knew you'd be here.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, your eyes were sparkling
as you looked up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wondered if, just maybe...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...You were actually planning on inviting me,
weren't you?"
choice_data_list: Because the stars were so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just as I thought.
You're always so quick to hold back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you want me to do, or any requests you have,
please put it into words and let me know, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Holding it in is a no-no, you know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because I always want
to spoil you rotten, Trainer♪

After gazing at the starry sky with Super Creek for a while,
we headed home.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well... fufu, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's just say
I wanted to look at the starry sky with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Please let me stay by your side just a little longer♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's cute how you're not being honest with yourself, too.

"It felt as though my true thoughts had been seen right through.
Feeling slightly awkward, the two of us gazed up at the starry sky for a while."
